calls.prompt:
Company: Brightside Foods Co.

US mid-size packaged food company (~900 employees, plants in Ohio and Georgia). Makes hot dogs and sausages, brightly colored gummy candy, and pecan-and-apple snack bars. Buys pecans, apples and corn from US farms. Sells through grocery chains and convenience stores (many customers pay with SNAP / food stamps). Runs its own fleet of 40 delivery trucks. No restaurants, no alcohol, no exports.

Rules that APPLY:
- FDA food additive and color additive rules (dyes in candy, casings, meat)
- Food labeling and food safety rules for packaged food and meat products
- EPA pesticide residue limits on crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn)
- USDA marketing orders and grading for pecans and apples
- SNAP rules that change what shoppers can buy or who qualifies (affects demand)
- Workplace safety and labor rules for food plants; trucking safety rules for our fleet

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Aviation, airspace, aircraft airworthiness
- Banking, securities, crypto, sanctions
- Medicare/Medicaid payment rules, medical devices
- Mining, offshore oil and gas, fisheries
- Broadcast/TV licensing

Affected areas and owners:
- food-safety: Additives, dyes, labeling, food safety → Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
- sourcing: Ingredients from farms, pesticide limits, crop rules → Tom Alvarez (Sourcing)
- sales: Retail channels, SNAP, pricing → Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance)
- operations: Plant safety, labor, trucking fleet → Ben Kowalski (Operations)

Task: Find every US Federal Register document published between 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-30 (inclusive) that affects this company. For each, give the Federal Register document number, title, federalregister.gov URL, the key deadline, a tier (Critical if it is a rule or proposed rule with a deadline less than 90 days after 2026-10-30, or a final rule that took effect within the 30 days before 2026-10-30; otherwise High for final rules, Medium for proposed rules and for notices with a deadline, Low for anything else), the owner area, a one-line reason, and a one-line action. Only include items you found via search. Return an empty list if none.
calls.output:
I found two documents in the 2026-10-26 to 2026-10-30 window that affect Brightside Foods. My searches had gaps, so the list may be incomplete (see the end).

## 1. EPA: Dimethyl Sulfoxide in Pesticide Formulations; Exemptions From the Requirement of a Tolerance
- **Document number:** 2026-22176
- **URL:** https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/30/2026-22176/dimethyl-sulfoxide-in-pesticide-formulations-exemptions-from-the-requirement-of-a-tolerance
- **Published:** 2026-10-30 (final rule)
- **Key deadline:** The rule was filed 10-29-26 and published Oct 30. I assumed it took effect on publication, which is EPA's usual practice for tolerance actions. The retrieved text did not show the effective date or the objection deadline. EPA usually allows 60 days for objections, which would be about Dec 29, 2026, but I did not confirm that.
- **Tier:** Critical. This is a final rule that I assume took effect within the 30 days before Oct 30.
- **Owner area:** sourcing (Tom Alvarez)
- **Reason:** It exempts dimethyl sulfoxide from the tolerance requirement when used as a solvent or cosolvent in pesticide formulations applied to growing crops or to raw agricultural commodities after harvest. That could cover the pecan, apple and corn farms we buy from.
- **Action:** Tom should ask pecan, apple and corn suppliers whether their spray programs use DMSO-containing products. He should confirm there is no change to our residue specifications and note the objection deadline.

## 2. FDA: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Color Additive Certification
- **Document number:** 2026-21913
- **URL:** https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/28/2026-21913/agency-information-collection-activities-submission-for-office-of-management-and-budget-review
- **Published:** 2026-10-28 (notice)
- **Key deadline:** The retrieved text did not show the comment due date. OMB-review notices usually allow 30 days, which would be about Nov 27, 2026, but I did not confirm that.
- **Tier:** Medium. It is a notice with a comment deadline.
- **Owner area:** food-safety (Maria Chen)
- **Reason:** It renews OMB Control No. 0910-0216, which covers FDA's batch certification of color additives used in foods, drugs, cosmetics and medical devices. Batch certification is required for all color additives listed in 21 CFR part 74 and those provisionally listed in part 82. Our bright gummy candy dyes are likely in those categories. User fees support the certification program, so fees could affect dye costs.
- **Action:** Maria should check the notice for the comment due date. She should decide whether to comment, and should confirm with dye suppliers that they hold current certification for the lots we buy.

## Gaps in the search
- I did not find qualifying documents for OSHA, apple marketing orders and grading, or SNAP in the Oct 26–30 window.
- I excluded the FMCSA exemption notices published in this window. They are specific to other carriers (for example R.B. Stewart, PAM Transport and Loomis) and do not change our fleet's obligations.
- Several relevant documents fall just outside the window, so I left them out. They are the Oct 23 SNAP EBT proposed rule, and the Nov 9 and Nov 10 pecan marketing order, FDA color additive and SNAP categorical-eligibility documents.
